fact: On 11 November 2025 ONECI and Société Générale Côte d'Ivoire signed a partnership by which the bank can verify its customers' identity in real time against the RNPP through ONECI's online authentication service.
title: L'ONECI ET LA SGCI SCELLENT UN PARTENARIAT STRATEGIQUE POUR UNE AUTHENTIFICATION NUMERIQUE FIABLE
